tower.title: One brick holds the question
tower.description: Pull the bottom rose brick; forty-two upper bricks lose their support.

gravity.title: The room lets go
gravity.description: An entry threshold releases a hinged trapdoor, suspended cargo and a leaning pole.

mass.title: Same force, different mass
mass.description: Equal-size PointBody spheres: 1, 2 and 4 kg; a matched one-newton pulse.

trolley.title: Load changes the push
trolley.description: Load the cart and pull its hand grip. A low-friction sliding carrier with decorative wheels.

puzzle.title: Make room for a body
puzzle.description: Three weighted cubes, staggered walls and destination marks; push and rearrange.

bowling.title: Ten pins, one commitment
bowling.description: Ten compound rigid pins, a black sphere, long lane, bumpers and banked sides.

recoil.title: The launcher also moves
recoil.description: Compare equal opposite impulses on free and braced carts.

friction.title: The slope does not choose the ending
friction.description: Four slopes compare cube/ball and smooth/rough contact; trajectories leave trails.

liquids.title: Walk into resistance
liquids.description: Three large transparent drag regions slow falling points and the visitor. Approximate drag and buoyancy, not fluid simulation.

springs.title: Pull one, disturb the row
springs.description: Seven hanging familiar points share restoring springs; pull one and disturb its neighbours.

swings.title: How long should a disturbance last
swings.description: Three connected swing pairs compare weak, medium and strong damping.

torque.title: Where you push matters
torque.description: A gate, seesaw and crank retain actual hinges while rose hand grips transmit forces.

constraints.title: Attachment changes the possible
constraints.description: Basket, three-link chain, suspended plank and articulated arm use physical joints.

magnet.title: The catch must end
magnet.description: A large timed magnet attracts twelve prefabs for three seconds. A held point also becomes a trigger-driven gravity gun.

vortex.title: The field takes a turn
vortex.description: Eighteen prefabs move through a visible swirl; the visitor meets the same acceleration field.

mutual.title: You become another source
mutual.description: Five larger orbiting points; the visitor becomes the sixth source. Softened attraction with contact disabled.

support.title: Move a leg, inherit the load
support.description: Move an actual table leg beneath a tall uneven load; contacts decide the collapse.

flight.title: A mat, two points, a way through
flight.description: Two inherited trigger-thrust points carry the visitor and a visual flying mat through four elevated gates.
